title: There's a whole BOT economy based on undercutting/scamming

posts.cooked:
Go to AH, sell ANY item resource, herb, ore, enchanting material, leather, bone, food.

Every time there are a few items OUTLIERS in prices, many times 50% less than the market value.

EG one herb sells 10g. a bot will post 24/7 at 5g or 3g.. or whatever, put some other items near there, so 5g-3g-3.99g. to fool the naive average npc player. Then he can buyout the items and resell for profit!

This is PARASITE scam economy. it is SCAM. yet we cant report the bot-chars. often they are in BB AH, ratchet AH, Exodar, taurenbluff AH etc, places where little people go.

Why blizzard allow this??? WAKE UP
